The Stuck Not Broken books.

Three books that take you through Polyvagal Theory and what to do with it. Book 1 explains what's happening in your nervous system. Book 2 helps you build real safety in your body. Book 3 takes you into your stuck defensive states and back out.

Read them in order

Each book stands on its own, but they're written as a progression. Book 3 leans on the safety you practice in Book 2, and Book 2 leans on the theory from Book 1. They're written for anyone, not just clinicians, so there's no jargon to get past.

Book 01 · Theory

Trauma & the Polyvagal Paradigm

This is the starting point. It explains the science of your nervous system in language anyone can read, so you can understand why you feel and behave the way you do. That understanding alone eases a lot of self-judgment, blame, and shame.

What's inside
  • What Polyvagal Theory is and why it changes how you understand recovery.
  • Plain language the whole way through. No prerequisites and no clinical background required.
  • A new way to hold your life story that doesn't depend on a trauma narrative.

Book 02 · Practice

Building Safety

Book 2 moves from knowing into doing. It's hands-on practice for building real safety in your body and your day, with step-by-step exercises you can use to regulate your nervous system and build resilience over time.

What's inside
  • Six safety-anchor pathways you can customize to your own body.
  • A simple mindfulness technique for the felt sense of safety.
  • Strategies for adding cues of safety into ordinary days.

Unstucking Defense

What's inside

Common questions

01

Do I have to read them in order?

No, but it helps. Each book stands on its own. Together they're a progression: theory, then safety, then unstucking.

02

Is this a substitute for therapy?

No. The books teach the framework and practice that support recovery. They are not a replacement for working with a licensed clinician.

03

PDF or Kindle, what's the difference?

The PDF is a direct download from this site (no account, no app). Kindle is the same book on Amazon, formatted for the Kindle app and e-readers.

04

What if I don't know where to start?

Start with Book 1. If you already know Polyvagal Theory, start with Book 2.
